svg.aria-label: The escalation ladder for data under load: index, then cache, then replicas, then shard last. Each rung buys headroom — fast reads, read headroom, read scale, write headroom — and bills a new failure class: write cost on every insert, staleness and stampedes, replication lag and failover itself, routing and rebalancing with no cross-shard transactions.
